/* saleson.shop.brand.BrandMapper.getBrandList */ SELECT BRND.BRAND_ID , BRND.BRAND_NAME , BRND.BRAND_IMAGE , BRND.BRAND_CONTENT , BRND.DISPLAY_FLAG , BRND.LOCGOV_CODE , ( SELECT CASE WHEN LOCGOV.LOCGOV_CODE = LOCGOV.UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE THEN LOCGOV.UPPER_LOCGOV_NM ELSE CONCAT(LOCGOV.UPPER_LOCGOV_NM, ' ', LOCGOV.LOCGOV_NM) END FROM G_LOCGOV LOCGOV WHERE LOCGOV.LOCGOV_CODE = BRND.LOCGOV_CODE ) AS LOCGOV_NAME FROM OP_BRAND BRND
ORDER BY BRAND_NAME
